rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun construction for the event of a person or thing reaching a place.

example.traditional: 阿明嘅到埗令大家好開心。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 ge3 dou3 bou6 ling6 daai6 gaa1 hou2 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use this noun phrase for a person or thing that has just arrived, especially when identifying a new arrival.

example.english: The new arrival has already taken a seat.
example.traditional: 啱啱到嘅新同事已經坐低喇。
example.jyutping: ngaam1 ngaam1 dou3 ge3 san1 tung4 si6 ji5 ging1 co5 dai1 laa3

rows.note: Use this formal construction when A is a time or event that is coming or reaching its appointed point.

example.english: The arrival of the summer solstice marks the beginning of midsummer.
example.traditional: 夏至嘅到臨標誌住盛夏開始。
example.jyutping: haa6 zi3 ge3 dou3 lam4 biu1 zi3 zyu6 sing6 haa6 hoi1 ci2
